% Resilient railway timetable rescheduling after disruption.
%@ meta id=hsr_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: High‑speed railway disruption‑aware timetable rescheduling
%@ desc :: MILP model that decides departure times, track recovery decisions and
%@ desc :: quantifies unmet passenger demand to enhance seismic resilience.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains (each train follows a single
%@ desc :: origin‑destination leg).
%@ param orig_dep shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Original planned departure time of each train.
%@ param travel_time shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Nominal travel time of each train’s leg.
%@ param demand shape=T kind=vector domain=passengers :: Dynamic passenger demand after disruption.
%@ param capacity shape=T kind=vector domain=passengers :: Maximum passengers that can be served if the track is recovered.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=big_M :: Big‑M constant for conditional constraints.
%@ param pen_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight of departure delay in the objective.
%@ param pen_unmet shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight of unmet passenger demand in the objective.
%@ var dep shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Actual departure time of each train.
%@ var arr shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Arrival time at the destination of each train.
%@ var delay shape=T domain=continuous role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Delay of each train (departure minus original schedule).
%@ var y shape=T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: Binary recovery decision for the track used by each train (1 if recovered).
%@ var unmet shape=T domain=continuous role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Unmet passenger demand for each train.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_resilience combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of total delay and unmet demand.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of delay.
%@ con travel_recovery kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Travel feasibility conditioned on track recovery.
%@ con unmet_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Unmet demand definition.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \mathit{pen\_delay} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} delay_{t}
            + \mathit{pen\_unmet} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} unmet_{t}
            \tag{total\_resilience} \\
  & delay_{t} \;-\; dep_{t} \;+\; orig\_dep_{t} \;\ge\; 0
            \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}
            \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & arr_{t} \;-\; dep_{t} \;-\; travel\_time_{t} \;+\; \mathit{M}
    \;-\; \mathit{M} \cdot y_{t} \;\ge\; 0
            \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}
            \tag{travel\_recovery} \\
  & unmet_{t} \;-\; demand_{t} \;+\; capacity_{t} \cdot y_{t} \;\ge\; 0
            \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}
            \tag{unmet\_def}
\end{align}

%@ meta id=hsr_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: High‑speed railway disruption‑resilient timetable rescheduling
%@ desc :: MILP model for rescheduling train departures after a seismic disruption, accounting for track and station recovery decisions and dynamic demand. Binary variables indicate whether a track segment or station is recovered; train cancellation is allowed. Objective balances departure delays against recovery costs.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index A ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Track arcs (segments between stations).
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ param w shape=T kind=vector domain=weight :: Importance weight of train t (e.g., passenger volume).
%@ param orig_dep shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Original planned departure time of train t.
%@ param arc_cost shape=A kind=vector domain=money :: Cost to recover arc a.
%@ param station_cost shape=S kind=vector domain=money :: Cost to recover station s.
%@ param path shape=T,A kind=matrix domain=bool :: 1 if arc a belongs to the fixed route of train t, 0 otherwise.
%@ param stop shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=bool :: 1 if train t stops at station s, 0 otherwise.
%@ var tau shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Rescheduled departure time of train t.
%@ var c shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Cancellation indicator of train t (1 if cancelled).
%@ var y shape=A domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Recovery indicator of arc a (1 if recovered).
%@ var z shape=S domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Recovery indicator of station s (1 if recovered).
%@ obj sense=min name=resilience_obj combination=sum :: Minimize weighted departure delays plus recovery costs.
%@ con departure_after_original kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Departure cannot be earlier than original schedule.
%@ con arc_recovery_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: If a train runs, all arcs on its route must be recovered.
%@ con station_recovery_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: If a train runs, all stations it stops at must be recovered.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} w_{t} \cdot \tau_{t}
            - \sum_{a \in \mathcal{A}} \mathit{arc\_cost}_{a} \cdot y_{a}
            - \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{station\_cost}_{s} \cdot z_{s}
            \tag{resilience\_obj} \\
  & \tau_{t} \ge \mathit{orig\_dep}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}
            \tag{departure\_after\_original} \\
  & y_{a} + c_{t} \ge \mathit{path}_{t,a} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; a \in \mathcal{A}
            \tag{arc\_recovery\_link} \\
  & z_{s} + c_{t} \ge \mathit{stop}_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s \in \mathcal{S}
            \tag{station\_recovery\_link} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=hsr_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: High-speed railway post-disruption timetable rescheduling with recovery and dynamic demand
%@ desc :: MILP model for assigning train start times after an earthquake, considering edge outage, recovery decisions, and serving time‑varying passenger demand. Objective maximizes kept original schedule and served demand.
%@ tags :: milp | railway | resilience | recovery | dynamic_demand
%@ index L ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Discrete time periods.
%@ index E ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Track edges.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ param a shape=L,T kind=matrix domain=bool :: Original timetable indicator (1 if train l originally scheduled at period t).
%@ param out shape=E,T kind=matrix domain=bool :: Edge outage indicator (1 if edge e unavailable at period t).
%@ param travel shape=L,E kind=matrix domain=bool :: Train‑edge incidence (1 if train l traverses edge e).
%@ param capserve shape=L,S,S kind=matrix domain=capacity :: Train capacity contributed to OD pair (i,j) when train l runs (0 if not serving that pair).
%@ param demand shape=S,S,T kind=matrix domain=passenger :: Dynamic passenger demand between stations i and j at period t.
%@ param alpha shape=- kind=scalar domain=weight :: Weight for preserving original schedule.
%@ var y shape=L,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Decision variable, 1 if train l starts at period t in the recovered timetable.
%@ var w shape=E,T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Edge recovery activation at period t (1 if recovery of edge e is initiated at t).
%@ var r shape=E,T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Edge operational status at period t (1 if edge e is usable at t).
%@ var served shape=S,S,T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Amount of passenger demand between stations i and j served at period t.
%@ obj sense=max name=total_resilience combination=sum :: Maximize weighted kept schedule plus served demand.
%@ con train_one_time kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train assigned exactly one start period.
%@ con edge_cumulative kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Cumulative definition of edge operational status.
%@ con edge_availability kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Train can run only if traversed edges are operational.
%@ con demand_capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Served demand cannot exceed capacity offered by scheduled trains.
%@ con demand_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Served demand limited by actual demand.
\begin{align}
  \max\quad & \mathit{alpha} \cdot \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}, t \in \mathcal{T}} a_{l,t} \, y_{l,t} \; + \; \sum_{i \in \mathcal{S}, j \in \mathcal{S}, t \in \mathcal{T}} served_{i,j,t} \tag{total\_resilience} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{l,t} = 1 \qquad \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{train\_one\_time} \\
  & r_{e,t} - r_{e,t-1} - w_{e,t} = 0 \qquad \forall e \in \mathcal{E},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{edge\_cumulative} \\
  & y_{l,t} + travel_{l,e} \cdot out_{e,t} - r_{e,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall l \in \mathcal{L},\; t \in \mathcal{T},\; e \in \mathcal{E} \tag{edge\_availability} \\
  & served_{i,j,t} \le \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} capserve_{l,i,j} \cdot y_{l,t} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{S},\; j \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{demand\_capacity} \\
  & served_{i,j,t} \le demand_{i,j,t} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{S},\; j \in \mathcal{S},\; t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{demand\_limit}
\end{align}
